create.name: Michelle Coutinho
create.bio:
Michelle Coutinho, who goes by Michelle Infinity online, is an American voice mentor, devotional singer and meditation teacher. She met Ram Dass's recorded talks as a teenager and Reiki even earlier, and later joined his Open Heart conversations and spent time with him on Maui, which shaped her sense of what a spiritual teacher does. Over some twenty years she has worked as a college lecturer in interface design, a creative consultant, a yoga and meditation teacher and a retreat leader, and she has sung in ceremony for more than fifteen years, including leading group voicework inside the Great Pyramid.

Her chanting draws on Bhakti yoga and on prayers in Sanskrit, Hebrew, Aramaic and Tibetan, sung in many languages. Her main offering is a private, application-based mentorship she calls vocal empowerment: a soul-centred coaching process that helps leaders, healers and creative people trust their own voice, speak with presence and act from integrity, with longer immersions for those who want them. On her YouTube channel, Tuning to Wisdom, she shares mantra teachings, guided meditations, voice workshops and astrology talks, and she also offers meditations on Insight Timer.
